title: Lab 23 — Securing AI Workloads with IAM and KMS
description: Apply least-privilege IAM policies, customer managed KMS keys and VPC endpoints to secure an AI workload, and locate the boundary of the AWS shared responsibility model.

steps.title: Step 1: Map the shared responsibility model onto an AI workload
Step 2: Write a least-privilege IAM policy scoped to specific Bedrock models
Step 3: Create a KMS customer managed key for AI data
Step 4: Encrypt a training data bucket at rest, and understand encryption in transit
Step 5: Keep AI traffic off the public internet with VPC endpoints
